Package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.exception

package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.exception
The errors the domain raises about itself, all under DomainException.

Each names a capture rule that was broken: a court with no active camera, a buffer with nothing to freeze, a camera installed twice, a clip that could not be assembled. Invalid arguments use IllegalArgumentException instead, and storage failures belong to the application's ports, not here.

  • Exception Classes
    Class
    Description
    ClipAssemblyException
    Thrown when a camera kept the seconds but the file that should hold them could not be written — the video tool failed, timed out, or the disk refused.
    DomainException
    Root of every error the model raises about itself.
    DuplicateCameraException
    Thrown when a camera is installed under an id the gym already uses.
    EmptyBufferException
    Thrown when a clip is asked of a camera that has not recorded enough footage yet — typically one switched on seconds ago.
    NoActiveCameraException
    Thrown when a capture is triggered on a court whose cameras are all inactive or under maintenance.
